reviews.title: The perfect privacy app for work and home.
reviews.text: This app is a sanity saver. It allows me to automatically block work apps when I’m at home. If my younger children want to play in my phone I can block all apps including those calls that you dread having to explain how your three year old just called your boss at 6 am and you had no clue.  It allows me to block callers that I deject indubitably without having to set up groups, and it doesn’t put a box with the blocked apps in my lives try unlike AppleCare’s.  The apps don’t even show up as installed anymore. This is a combination of screen time restrictions and apples app hide, combined in one easy to use configuration. Now if they offered file and photo hiding it would be an all in one life saving app!
